reason: The landlord (event-001) only wants the current solar generation readings. It is an information request with no fault, deadline or contractor, so no approval or provider is involved. We have asked the tenant four times (events 6, 10, 13, 16). In event-17 he says the readings were supplied about two weeks ago by his wife, by phone and email. No figures or image are in the case, and nothing in the request shows a reading received. That is a claim I cannot verify, and it is not a safety or fraud issue. The tenant has just replied, so chasing again or waiting is not appropriate. Escalating is not needed yet. I have asked him to resend the figure or a photo and to say when and from which address his wife emailed, so that staff can trace the earlier message. The case should not close and the landlord should not be told it is done, as no reading is in the case. If a reading turns up in another mailbox or call log, we can pass it to Edwin. If there is still no reading after this reply, a person should check the office inbox and call log. Event-005 also marked approval as given without any landlord approval message; this is moot because no work is being instructed.
message: Dear Ivo, thank you for your reply, and apologies for the repeated messages. We cannot see the readings against this request, so they may have been logged elsewhere. Could you or your wife resend the current kWh figure from the generation meter or inverter display, or a photo of the screen? If you can, please also tell us roughly what date and which email address your wife used, so we can trace the earlier message. Kind regards, Maya Chen, Northbridge Lettings
unknowns: Whether the wife's earlier call or email exists and where it was logged
options: Wait for tenant to resend the reading
Staff search office inbox and call log for the earlier reading
Update the landlord once a reading is received
